From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: NovaFlow discovery — pricing & committed-use details

Hi John — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and next steps from our call: 

1) Short summary of your use case
- Customer support assistant + summarization pipeline for product analytics.
- Expected peak QPS moderate; heavy token usage in summaries and embeddings for reranking.

2) High-level current usage estimate (from call)
- Avg monthly tokens today: ~50M
- 3–6 month growth plan: 200M+ tokens/month if pilot scales

3) Budget / target unit economics (what we discussed)
- You mentioned wanting to target ~$1,000 per 1M tokens (ballpark) as a planning figure — helpful to know.

4) Pricing levers we can apply
- Startup program: credits + additional % off list for qualifying early-stage companies.
- Committed-use discounts (12/24/36 mo): larger % off for longer and higher commits.
- Multi-model routing (cheaper model for non-sensitive traffic) and quantization can materially lower effective $/1M.

5) What I need from you to get a formal quote
- Monthly token breakdown (frontend generation vs. summarization vs. embeddings) — CSV is best.
- Target contract length (12 vs 24 vs 36 mo) and desired minimum monthly commit.

Next steps
- If you can share the usage CSV, I’ll model three committed-use options (12/24/36 months) and show effective $/1M after discounts and startup credits.
- I’ll also include an example committed-use agreement and a short ROI table.

Attachments request: please send your last 3 months of monthly token totals if possible (CSV).

Thanks — looping Ben on pricing approvals for anything >30% off.

Best,
Marissa Cole

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: John Ellis <john@novaflow.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: NovaFlow discovery — pricing & committed-use details

Hi John — thanks for the CSV, that’s perfect. I ran three model scenarios and put together high-level committed-use options (summary below). I also attached the standard committed-use docs (CommittedUse_Docs.pdf) for legal/procurement review.

Quick summary (effective $/1M tokens) — approximate, modeled on Redwood hosted inference for our verified open model family with mixed routing and quantization options:

Scenario A — 12 month commit (conservative)
- Commit: 50M tokens/mo (annualized 600M)
- Base list: $1,200 per 1M tokens
- Standard committed-use discount (12 mo): 15% -> effective $1,020/1M
- Startup program credit (Series A eligibility): additional 10% applied as billing credit in addition to committed discount -> effective post-credit $918/1M

Scenario B — 24 month commit (recommended tradeoff)
- Commit: 150M tokens/mo (annualized 1.8B)
- Base list: $1,200/1M
- Committed-use discount (24 mo): 25% -> $900/1M
- Startup credit: 10% -> effective post-credit $810/1M

Scenario C — 36 month / high commit (maximum savings)
- Commit: 300M tokens/mo (annualized 3.6B)
- Base list: $1,200/1M
- Committed-use discount (36 mo): 35% -> $780/1M
- Startup credit: 10% -> effective post-credit $702/1M

Notes on levers and assumptions:
- Base list is model-dependent; cheaper model variants or more aggressive quantization can lower base list by ~10–20% in many workloads.
- We show startup program as a billing credit (not stackable with an additional one-time credit) — total effective off the list is: committed discount + billing credit.
- For any request to go >35% total off list, that requires AE + Sales Ops & Finance approval (Ben is on CC).
- We can do quarterly true-ups vs committed usage to protect both parties.

Next steps I propose:
- I’ll generate a formal quote with committed quantities and payment cadence for the two scenarios you prefer (12 vs 24 vs 36).
- If we’re aligned on the 24 month scenario, I can draft the initial SOW and propose start/end dates for the commit.
- Ben: can you confirm whether we can extend startup credit to a prorated invoice credit for NovaFlow given Series A status?

If John/Team confirm the target committed level (e.g., 150M/mo) I’ll send a formal quote + estimated monthly invoice after discounts.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0199
